findings.current: The boatmen had already traveled this route once, and with the waterways memorized, they guided the vessel forward with practiced ease.
findings.defect: The draft reduces a completed trip there and back to traveling the route once.
findings.rationale: 오가며 indicates that the boatmen had traveled both ways, which explains their familiarity with the waterways.
findings.replacement: The boatmen had already made one round trip and learned the waterways, so they guided the vessel forward with practiced ease.
findings.source: 이미 한차례 오가며 물길을 익힌 수부들은 능숙하게 선박을 몰아 나아갔다.

findings.current: But if the Wudang Sect’s famed Supreme Peak master, Perfected Being Hyeongong—also known as the Paper-Folding Grandpa—and Cheongpung had done it, it wasn’t impossible.
findings.defect: The narrator's comic self-correction is turned into an invented alias, and 아저씨 is changed to “Grandpa.”
findings.rationale: 종이접기 아저씨, 아니 is Taekyung jokingly calling Hyeongong “Origami Man” before correcting himself, not supplying an established sobriquet.
findings.replacement: But with Origami Man—no, Perfected Being Hyeongong, the Supreme Peak master Wudang was so proud of—and Cheongpung, it was entirely possible.
findings.source: 하지만 종이접기 아저씨, 아니 무당파가 자랑하는 초절정 고수인 현공진인과 청풍이라면 못할 것도 없다.

findings.current: “Don’t lump me in with them. It’s insulting.”
findings.defect: The referent is reversed. Mungyeong objects to Jeok Cheongang grouping him with Jeok's generation, not to being grouped with the young monsters.
findings.rationale: Jeok has just generalized about “when we were young.” Mungyeong rejects that grouping, prompting Jeok to challenge him about how young he was when he reached the Supreme Peak realm.
findings.replacement: “Don’t lump me in with you. It’s insulting.”
findings.source: “나까지 한 묶음으로 엮지 마라. 기분 나쁘니까.”

findings.current: “Of course. You’re the only human who travels around with a horned serpent.”
findings.defect: The draft drops the explicit water-snake description.
findings.rationale: 물뱀 specifically means “water snake,” and the insulting physical description is the basis of Taekyung's joke.
findings.replacement: “Of course. You’re the only human who travels around with a horned water snake.”
findings.source: “당연하지. 뿔 달린 물뱀이랑 다니는 인간은 당신밖에 없으니까.”

findings.current: Under ordinary circumstances, simple folk who worshiped the Emperor as the Son of Heaven would instantly change their tune when a flood or earthquake struck, declaring that the country had fallen under an evil omen.
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicit Hyuk Mujin callback that characterizes the speed and extremity of the public's about-face.
findings.rationale: 혁무진 급 is a direct comic comparison to Hyuk Mujin, not merely an intensifier meaning “instantly.”
findings.replacement: Under ordinary circumstances, the simple folk who fawned over the Son of Heaven would pull a Hyuk Mujin-level about-face the moment a flood or earthquake struck, declaring it an omen of the nation’s ruin.
findings.source: 평상시에는 천자님, 천자님 하면서 떠받드는 순박한 백성들도 홍수나 지진이 일어나면 나라에 망조가 들었다며 혁무진 급 태세 전환을 보여 준다.

findings.current: And if a plague came along as part of a buy-two-get-one-free deal, the people of this era would grab the hoes they had been using to till their fields and charge out to overturn the country.
findings.defect: The farming implement is changed from a pickaxe to a hoe.
findings.rationale: 곡괭이 is a pickaxe; preserving the heavier improvised weapon maintains the source's physical image.
findings.replacement: And if a plague came along as part of a buy-two-get-one-free deal, the people of this era would grab the pickaxes they had been using to till their fields and charge out to overturn the country.
findings.source: 거기에 2+1 행사로 역병까지 따라붙는 날에는 밭 갈던 곡괭이로 나라를 갈아엎겠다며 뛰쳐나오는 게 이 시대의 분위기였다.

findings.current: “And why are you walking so slowly? Even your grandmother would be faster than you.”
findings.defect: The draft reverses the kinship reference from Jeok Cheongang's grandmother to Zhuge Feng's grandmother.
findings.rationale: 노부의 할머니 explicitly means “this old man's grandmother,” making Jeok's own grandmother the absurd comparison.
findings.replacement: “And why are you walking so slowly? Even this old man’s grandmother would be faster than you.”
findings.source: “그리고 발걸음이 왜 이리 느려 터졌느냐? 네놈보다 노부의 할머니가 더 빠르겠다.”

findings.defect: The draft omits the closing narration that explicitly characterizes the System notification as intensely ominous and describes it piercing Taekyung's ears.
findings.rationale: 불길하기 짝이 없는 is the chapter's final emotional beat and establishes Taekyung's immediate foreboding rather than ending on an uncharacterized sound.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
>
> *Beep.*

An utterly ominous System notification pierced my ears.
findings.source:
삐빅.

불길하기 짝이 없는 시스템 알림이 귓가를 파고들었다.

summary: One critical kinship reversal, two major losses of characterization or narration, and five localized fidelity defects.
